title: AI Through the Human Lens: Investigating Cognitive Theories in Machine Psychology
reasoning: The paper uses the Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) as one of its four primary evaluative frameworks. It specifically benchmarks how LLMs respond to ethical dilemmas and moral dimensions such as care/harm and fairness/cheating, including the use of an 'Annotator System Prompt' designed to assess the moral correctness of model answers.
